headline: A 2022 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Middleburg, Florida, after Andrew K. Baker.
what_it_does: This law names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic at 400 College Drive in Middleburg, Florida, the Andrew K. Baker Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic. The clinic may also be called the A.K. Baker VA Clinic. The law also contains other provisions, but the official summary provided does not describe them.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 5, 2022.
